Web.csproj still references Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite, SQLitePCLRaw.bundle_e_sqlite3, and ContestJudging.Infrastructure. No change from original audit.

ARCH-002.reaudit_notes: ContestManager.cs uses IDatabaseBackupService instead of ContestDbContext. No using ContestJudging.Infrastructure.Persistence import. Tests updated to mock IDatabaseBackupService. Fully remediated.

ARCH-003.reaudit_notes: IContestManager still in Services.Managers, IValidationService still in Services.Validation, IPartitionService still in Services.Partitioning, IGlobalRankingService still in Services.Resolution. No change from original audit. Exacerbated by RA-ARCH-003.

ARCH-004.reaudit_notes: ExportDatabaseAsync and ImportDatabaseAsync removed from ContestDbContext. Methods now live in DatabaseBackupService (Infrastructure). Fully remediated.

ARCH-005.title: Composition root in Services layer instead of outermost layer
ARCH-005.reaudit_notes: AddContestJudgingServices still in Services.Extensions. Services.csproj still references Infrastructure. No change from original audit.

ARCH-006.title: Two IScoringStrategy implementations never registered in DI
ARCH-006.reaudit_notes: Only LinearSpacingScoring registered (line 33). PercentileScoring and DefinedIntervalScoring still exist but not wired. No change from original audit.

ARCH-007.title: AddScoped DbContext lifetime in Blazor WASM
ARCH-007.reaudit_notes: AddDbContext<ContestDbContext> still used (line 23). No AddDbContextFactory replacement. No ChangeTracker.Clear() calls. Informational finding remains valid.

ARCH-008.title: No consistent rule for interface placement
ARCH-008.reaudit_notes: Repository/scoring interfaces in Core, service interfaces in Services. No documented rationale. Exacerbated by new IBackupService in Core (RA-ARCH-003).

new_findings.title: BackupService in Services layer depends on Blazored.LocalStorage platform-specific package
new_findings.rule_violated: Clean Architecture Dependency Rule — the Services/Application layer should not depend on platform/framework-specific packages. Blazored.LocalStorage is a Blazor browser-localStorage abstraction, which is a presentation/infrastructure concern.
new_findings.mitigation: In Blazor WASM, browser localStorage is the sole persistent storage mechanism (no server-side file system, no IndexedDB adapter in this project), making Blazored.LocalStorage analogous to a database driver. The IBackupService abstraction is correctly in Core; only the implementation's package dependency is concerning. Risk is theoretical unless targeting non-Blazor platforms.
new_findings.remediation: Option A: Accept Blazored.LocalStorage as infrastructure-level dependency (pragmatic for WASM-only). Option B: Extract BackupService to a dedicated adapter project (ContestJudging.Infrastructure.LocalStorage) or move to Web project.

new_findings.title: DatabaseBackupService factory hardcodes DB path independently of connection string parameter
new_findings.rule_violated: Principle of Least Surprise / Single Source of Truth — the DB path should be derived from the connection string. If connectionString is changed to a different path, the backup service operates on the wrong file.
new_findings.remediation: Parse Data Source from connectionString using SqliteConnectionStringBuilder and pass to DatabaseBackupService. Example: `var builder = new SqliteConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString); new DatabaseBackupService(builder.DataSource);`

new_findings.title: IBackupService and IDatabaseBackupService in Core exacerbate ARCH-008 interface placement inconsistency
new_findings.rule_violated: Architecture consistency — the split between Core-placed and Services-placed interfaces lacks documented rationale and diverges further with each new abstraction.
new_findings.remediation: Move IContestManager, IValidationService, IPartitionService, and IGlobalRankingService to Core.Interfaces to establish a single, consistent rule (all interfaces in Core). This would also resolve ARCH-003 and ARCH-008.

captive_dependency_analysis.notes: Blazor WASM environment: Scoped == Singleton due to absence of request scopes. No practical captive dependency risk. BackupService (Scoped) depends on ILocalStorageService (Singleton) — correct direction (shorter-lived depending on longer-lived is acceptable).

circular_dependency_analysis.notes: No circular dependencies detected. IDatabaseBackupService and IBackupService are independent abstractions. ContestManager depends on IDatabaseBackupService but not IBackupService. BackupService depends on IDatabaseBackupService but not ContestManager. Clean separation of concerns.

architecture_health.assessment: The most critical finding (ARCH-002 HIGH) is fully remediated. ContestManager is now properly decoupled from Infrastructure. ARCH-004 SRP violation is also resolved. However, 6 original findings remain open, including foundational Clean Architecture violations (ARCH-001 web→infrastructure coupling, ARCH-003 interface placement, ARCH-005 composition root location). The new abstractions (IDatabaseBackupService, IBackupService) are well-designed with proper layer discipline. Three minor new findings were identified (RA-ARCH-001 through RA-ARCH-003) — none high severity.
